bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest Bears story right now is that head coach Ben Johnson has confirmed Tyson Bagent will again start at quarterback this Sunday against the Green Bay Packers, with Caleb Williams still sidelined by his hamstring injury. Bears coach Ben Johnson said earlier in the day that Tyson Bagent will start Sunday's game against the Packers.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The biggest Lions story in the past day centers on encouraging injury news: the Detroit Lions are continuing to get positive injury news as Dan Campbell told 97.1 The Ticket that starting center Cade Mays is expected to return to practice this week, joining safety Brian Branch on the same recovery timeline. While Campbell cautioned that getting them going in practice this week doesn't mean they're going to play , the update comes as a much-needed boost for a Lions team looking to bounce back on both sides of the ball after a tough Week 4 loss to the Panthers.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers lost linebacker Edgerrin Cooper for the remainder of the season after an MRI confirmed an MRI confirmed that linebacker Edgerrin Cooper tore his Achilles in Sunday's 17-14 victory over the Buccaneers . With the defense now thin at linebacker, Green Bay has responded by working out free agents, including LB Deion Jones, DB Cobee Bryant, DB Dwight McGlothern, and LB Chris Paul Jones, a former second-round pick of the Falcons back in 2016 , while also signing Kristian Welch to the active roster ahead of their Week 5 home matchup against the Bears.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings signed veteran receiver Odell Beckham Jr. along with Jeshaun Jones to the practice squad on October 7, reuniting Beckham with head coach Kevin O'Connell as the team looks to add depth at wide receiver.
